name: North Miami
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in North Miami, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in North Miami, FL: the Christmas tree lighting at MOCA Plaza with Santa, treats and performances, plus Winter Wonderland toys.
lede: North Miami lights its Christmas tree at MOCA Plaza with Santa, treats and performances, and its District 3 councilwoman hosts a Winter Wonderland with free toys, rides and a bike raffle.
celebrates: The City of North Miami lists an Annual Christmas Tree Lighting at MOCA Plaza, 770 NE 125th Street, with Santa Claus as special guest, holiday treats, a photo op with Santa and special performances. Its Parks and Recreation department keeps a Celebrate page of special events that includes a Tree Lighting page. Winter Wonderland, hosted by District 3 Councilwoman Mary Estimé-Irvin with free toys, Santa, rides and a bike raffle, has been announced in city news for several years. In earlier years the city's calendar placed it at Griffing Park, with a holiday market, food for purchase, music, rides and games.
lastyear: On December 20, 2024, the City of North Miami invited everyone to its annual Winter Wonderland, hosted by Vice Mayor Mary Estimé-Irvin in partnership with the District 2 councilwoman. The city's news release said Santa Claus would make a special appearance to distribute free toys to children. That is the most recent city news release about the event that we could find. The city has also announced a free holiday food distribution and toy give-away with a family snow event.
facts: North Miami began as the Town of Arch Creek. Residents voted to incorporate on February 5, 1926, as the Town of Miami Shores, partly because the early eastern boundary was the Atlantic Ocean. The name changed to the Town of North Miami in 1931, and it became the City of North Miami in 1953. Arch Creek had a natural limestone bridge 40 feet across on Dade County's first roadway, and 2026 is the city's centennial year.
trains: North Miami grew around the Arch Creek Railroad Depot, and by 1905 the area around the nine year old depot was the community's hub, with a post office and a school nearby. Today Brightline's Aventura station is at 19796 West Dixie Highway and its MiamiCentral station is at 161 NW 6th Street. Metrorail's Green Line runs between Palmetto and Dadeland South, and Tri-Rail's Miami Airport station is at 3861 NW 21st Street. The Gold Coast Railroad Museum in Miami has its own page on our site.

kidfact: North Miami once had the Atlantic Ocean as its eastern edge, so for a few years it was named the Town of Miami Shores.
faq: Where is the North Miami Christmas tree lighting?

The city's Annual Christmas Tree Lighting takes place at MOCA Plaza, 770 NE 125th Street, North Miami. The city calendar lists Santa Claus as special guest, holiday treats, a photo op and special performances. Call 305-895-9840 with questions, and check the city's Tree Lighting page for any update to the plans.
What is Winter Wonderland in North Miami?

It is a holiday evening hosted by the District 3 councilwoman, with free toys, Santa, rides and a bike raffle announced for 2026. The councilwoman's post said the location would be announced and that registration would open soon, so watch the city's channels for the venue.
Why is 2026 special for North Miami?

The city is celebrating its centennial. Residents voted to incorporate on February 5, 1926, and the city runs a Centennial Celebration page with a historical lecture series, North Miami Through the Century.
Is there a Santa photo at the North Miami tree lighting?
Yes. The city's calendar lists a photo op with Santa as part of the evening, alongside holiday treats and special performances.
